integrity: Analytic derivation and reproducible finite arithmetic/trajectory checks included; numerical tests corroborate but do not replace analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite regular-contact 3-uniform hypergraphs, single-pathogen deterministic exponential mean-hazard closure, homogeneous initial marginals and critical pairwise intensity only. No assertion for stochastic SIS sample paths, two-virus states, heterogeneous orbits or all graph types. No independent audit.
title: Sharp extinction, bistability, and critical relaxation laws in overlap-reinforced hypergraph SIS closures
